fair_value_reason: P/E leg, 60%: horizon NTM EPS = 0.25 x CY27 $10.10 + 0.75 x CY28 $11.60 less 5% (thin 5-estimate panel, late cycle) = $10.79. SLAB is about neutral before purchase amortization (about -$0.31 financing against about $0.28 of 2028E NOPAT less SBC plus early synergies), so about $10.78. At 23x, the 20.7x core median plus an 11% premium for FCF conversion, owned capacity and capital returns, capped below ADI's 25x because ADI has higher margins and growth, that is $248. FCF leg, 40%: recurring FCF of about $10.0 a share ($9.1B on 912M shares) at 3.75% is $267, plus about $1 of CHIPS receivable still uncollected at the horizon, for $268. The blend is about $256, 13% below spot. Versus the round-2 forecaster mean of $260.6: removing the GAAP amortization deduction adds about $5; the lower justified multiple (ADI margin fact, agent 5's invalid GAAP argument) and a consistent FCF yield subtract about $9. My round-1 figure of $270 used 24.5x and a 3.5% yield.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 corrected the facts but anchored on my round-1 judgments. Fair values collapsed to $255-265 and applied multiples to 23.5-25x, and two of my round-1 claims turned out wrong and spread through the files: TXN does not have the industry-high gross margin (ADI is at 67.3%), and CY27 consensus has been flat at $10.10 for 30 days, not rising. At $293.8 TXN trades at 29x CY27, about 41% above a 20.7x core analog median and above ADI. I reconcile fair value to about $256 and keep the forecasters' ladder, shaded about 1% lower (median about $280). Each agent's scenario mean sits 9-12% above its fair value, which only reconciles if roughly 40-50% of the overvaluation closes within 12 months; no agent has stated or evidenced that.
key_drivers: Valuation: 29.1x CY27 LSEG consensus ($10.10; 29.9x on Zacks $9.84) against a 20.7x core analog/MCU median, a 41-44% premium, and above ADI (25.0x), which has higher margins (FQ3-26 GAAP GM 67.3% vs TI ~61%) and faster growth (+40% vs +23% y/y). A justified premium is about 5-15%, so the multiple likely keeps compressing even if numbers are met.

Cycle position: Q2-26 revenue +23% y/y against WSTS analog market growth of +10.2% in 2026 and +6.6% in 2027. TI is enforcing price increases on open POs and lead times are stretching (Fusion Greensheet), but ECIA sentiment has rolled over from its June peak and consensus CY27 EPS has been flat for 30 days. These are classic late-upcycle markers (2010, 2018 precedents).

FCF inflection: capex falls from $4.9B toward $2-3B while depreciation rises, and $2.16B of CHIPS incentives remain receivable. Recurring FCF is about $10 a share by 2028, and FCF exceeds net income through 2028. This is the one premium factor that clearly persists.

Silicon Labs: about $7.3B net outlay, closing H1-2027 (HSR expired May 22, 2026; other approvals pending). Net debt is about $12.3B at close and about $10.8B by Oct-2027 (about 1x EBITDA). About EPS-neutral before purchase amortization, which is non-GAAP-comparable with peers; GAAP dilution about $0.25-0.35.

Base rate: after >45% trailing 12-month gains, TXN's next-12-month median was +12% across 1990-2025 (57% positive, n=93 overlapping months) but -1% after 2003 (47% positive, n=38). This anchors a median near or slightly below spot.
